en: A black-and-white image shows a European street scene with several ornate, historic buildings. The building on the left has statues in its niches and typical late 19th–early 20th century architecture. The street leads to a larger building with a tower and spire, visible in the background. There are people in period clothing walking and two children pushing a cart. The roads and overall style suggest a Central or Eastern European city from the early 20th century.
